findings.evidence: ScheduleDialog (which renders ScheduleTree with ON AIR, VERSION accordion tree, and 기타 일정) is only mounted inside the unauthenticated guest return branch (`if (!user)` at line 461). The authenticated return branch at lines 716-801 still renders an inline Dialog with a flat `schedules.map(...)` list. Additionally, `ScheduleTree.renderSchedule` (lines 86-97) drops the `[비공식]` badge (`schedule.is_official === false`), slash-separated `<span className="block">` line breaks for `title` and `memo`, single-day date formatting (`start_date === end_date`), and type-specific badge colors, and renders the `버전별 일정` section even when `versions.length === 0`.
findings.impact: Authenticated users clicking [일정 보기] on /dashboard/games still see the legacy flat schedule list instead of the R42 ON AIR + VERSION accordion tree, and ScheduleTree lacks unofficial badges and slash-separated line-break formatting.
findings.recommendation: Replace the duplicate inline schedule Dialog in the authenticated view (lines 716-801) with `<ScheduleDialog>` (updating its description to cover both guest and authenticated contexts), and update `ScheduleTree` to preserve `[비공식]` badges, slash-separated `<span className="block">` line breaks for `title` and `memo`, single-day `(단일)` date formatting, schedule_type badge styling, version date range display on accordion headers, and conditional rendering of `버전별 일정` when `versions.length > 0`.
